title: Sloth dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='19' ry='21' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#d9b48a'/>
  <!-- left arm raised up -->
  <path d='M35 52 Q24 38 20 26' stroke='#a9774a' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm raised -->
  <path d='M65 52 Q76 40 80 30' stroke='#a9774a' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claws left -->
  <path d='M20 26 L15 17' stroke='#f2e3c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 26 L21 15' stroke='#f2e3c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 26 L27 17' stroke='#f2e3c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claws right -->
  <path d='M80 30 L85 21' stroke='#f2e3c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 30 L79 19' stroke='#f2e3c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M80 30 L73 21' stroke='#f2e3c8' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M40 80 Q32 86 28 82' stroke='#a9774a' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 80 Q68 88 74 85' stroke='#a9774a' stroke-width='9' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='17' fill='#c99a68'/>
  <!-- face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#e8cfae'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='37' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5b4030'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='37' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#5b4030'/>
  <!-- eyes happy closed -->
  <path d='M41 37 Q44 34 47 37' stroke='#ffe9c9' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 37 Q56 34 59 37' stroke='#ffe9c9' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#4a3327'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 47 Q50 51 55 47' stroke='#7a5a42' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little music notes -->
  <path d='M86 14 L86 24' stroke='#7ef0d0' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='83.5' cy='24.5' r='3' fill='#7ef0d0'/>
  <path d='M14 20 L14 28' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='11.8' cy='28.4' r='2.6' fill='#ffd166'/>
</svg>
